topic: EWA anisotropic Gaussian covariance low-pass filter vs sub-pixel splat singularity rig
topic_zh: EWA 椭圆加权平均协方差低通滤波正则化对比未正则化亚像素奇点闪烁
scope: Deterministic Zwicker et al. (2001) / Kerbl et al. (2023) 2x2 EWA screen-space covariance low-pass regularization (Sigma_2D + lambda*I_2) and energy-conserving determinant scaling versus unregularized perspective covariance inversion across 17 grazing tilt angles. No 3DGS scene optimization executed.

good_fit: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS / Mip-Splatting) tile rasterizers, point-cloud surface splatting, and anisotropic texture filtering
Explaining why convolving a 2D Gaussian splat with a pixel reconstruction filter equals adding lambda = 0.30 px^2 to the diagonal of Sigma_2D
Preventing det(Sigma_2D) -> 0 division-by-zero NaNs and sub-pixel needle shimmering on distant or grazing splats
Preserving screen-space integrated opacity energy via the analytical determinant factor sqrt(det(Sigma_2D) / det(Sigma_2D + lambda*I))
not_for: Axis-aligned 2D UI billboards with fixed integer pixel sizes that never undergo perspective foreshortening
Isotropic point sprites that ignore 3D covariance orientation and blur equally in all directions
Offline SfM camera calibration and multi-view 3DGS spherical harmonics optimization
Ray-traced triangle meshes that do not project elliptical covariance matrices to screen space
